raw_definitions: Definisi : a ~ answer, jawapan yg kasar. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adj 1. covered, with, full of dust, berhabuk, berdebu: a ~ room, bilik yg berhabuk; ~ roads, jalan yg berdebu; 2. ( of colour ) pudar, keabu-abuan: ~ pink, merah jambu pudar; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
